seo.title: Restaurants in Valley Junction, West Des Moines
keywords: where to eat in valley junction
seo.description: 5 restaurants in Valley Junction, West Des Moines, including Cooper's on 5th and Bix & Co., listed from the Des Moines Insider restaurant directory.

sections.content: The Des Moines Insider restaurant directory lists 5 restaurants in Valley Junction right now. The list below is read from it live and ordered by rating, and each name opens that restaurant's own page with the address, hours, price range and links the directory holds for it. Closed restaurants and ones that are announced but not yet open are left out.

faqs.answer: As of 2026-10-01, 5. By Google star rating, the highest rated are Cooper's on 5th (4.7), Bix & Co. (4.5) and St. Kilda Collective (4.5).
faqs.question: How many restaurants in Valley Junction does Des Moines Insider list?

faqs.answer: By the first cuisine each listing records, the most common are American (2). A place can record more than one cuisine; only the first is counted here.
faqs.question: What kinds of food do Valley Junction restaurants serve?

faqs.answer: This page lists restaurants in the Des Moines Insider directory whose map location falls inside the Valley Junction boundary this site uses (between Grand Avenue, Railroad Avenue, 1st Street and 8th Street). Restaurants marked closed, or announced but not yet open, are left out. A place that is not listed is not in the directory yet.
